reviews.text:
Since this clinic was acquired by a large chain, the customer service has become appalling. I spoke yesterday afternoon with an unpleasant and unprofessional receptionist who seemed bothered by having to interact with clients. I've been taking my cat to this clinic for five years and have recommended it to several friends who live in the area (I obviously don't anymore).

Inconvenient opening hours, poor customer service, and the staff's lack of responsiveness are unacceptable.

The service at this clinic has become truly unsatisfactory since they changed receptionists. I had been a client of this clinic for eight years and have since switched to another one. The new receptionist is uncooperative when problems arise with deliveries or when they need to process an exchange or refund, and email communications are full of errors or are simply confusing/incorrect.
Thank you so much for your trust and for this wonderful review. We are always happy to be able to support you and your companion 🐾 …

My dog ​​has cancer and his treatment is finished. I took him to the clinic for treatment and asked for a new prescription to buy his medication. They gave it to me personally, along with the website address to order it. I bought the medication, but the laboratory requires the veterinarian to send it by email or fax. However, the 4 Pattes clinic refused to do this simple thing. My dog ​​is still sick, without treatment, and risks dying because of a simple refusal to send a fax. This is unacceptable! I absolutely do not recommend this clinic.

Very happy to return to the clinic. Excellent service as usual at every stage. I'll mention that with the arrival of warmer weather, the temperature inside the clinic was quite high. Since we spent a pleasant amount of time in the waiting room, I thought I'd mention it as a point for improvement :) That's my only criticism; otherwise, it's number one! Thank you.

I would like to respond to the review left by Maude Methot below. I was at the clinic at the same time as the events she described. The receptionist was extremely patient, while this client was incredibly condescending towards her. Another client present even told Ms. Methot that she didn't appreciate the tone she was using with the receptionist; her tone was extremely aggressive and unacceptable under the circumstances. I have been going to this clinic for over 10 years. Yes, the staff changes, and as a business owner myself, I can say that we now deal with people who are rushed, stressed, and very aggressive. I have never had a problem being served. This woman needs to reconsider her approach and tone. Kudos to the clinic staff, and keep up the good work; we know it's not easy.

Extremely dissapointed with what this vet has become, in the last 6 months or so something has changed, no call backs when my dog had a hot spot that needed treatment. Had to go to another vet to get him treated.

Now I needed apoquel because my dog gets seasonal allergies, have been trying to call for 3 days to get a prescription filled after the vet wrote him one in June for his annual checkup.

I’ll never go back here

My partner and I were clients of the clinic for eight years and received excellent service from both the reception staff and the veterinarians.

However, we decided to change clinics following a recent incident involving the new receptionist.

After a call from the receptionist, I went to the clinic to pick up the pre-operative medications. She quickly searched a box and couldn't find them, apologized, and asked me to come back the next day for a new prescription because, according to her, the medications had been returned to inventory for some unexplained reason. I returned a second day to retrieve the bottle.

A few days later, I received a call from the same receptionist saying she had inadvertently forgotten to give me a second bottle of medication. I returned to the clinic a third time. Something seemed off, so I took some time at home to examine the bottles and realized that it was actually the same medication that had supposedly been lost the first time. If I hadn't checked the drug name and prescription dates, I would have given my cat two double doses of medication before his surgery under general anesthesia.

I went back to the vet a fourth time to show them the vials and express my dissatisfaction with the situation, explaining that the consequences could have been serious and that the clinic's current organization seems clearly flawed, and has been for several months (which also increases the chances of human error), although I also acknowledged that the presence of a new receptionist might contribute to the instability.
The vet apologized, explained that they were overwhelmed, that in the case of this particular medication it probably wouldn't have been dangerous for my cat, and that it was unfortunately a human error. She was sincere in her apology and clear in her explanations, but didn't seem to grasp that there were any organizational shortcomings at all.

However, the receptionist, who was standing next to me during the exchange, denied making a mistake by not looking properly the first time. She didn't apologize for potentially not looking properly the first time, nor for not taking the time to examine the second bottle before giving it to me, even though she herself found it strange not to have given it to me with the first. She became incensed when I mentioned that she was new and used passive-aggressive behavior with another customer, saying that it would be wonderful if all customers were as patient and empathetic as she was. Furthermore, she left and didn't return, leaving me at the counter after she finished with her customer.

This is the one and only time I have expressed dissatisfaction in eight years, and although I was firm and direct, I didn't use any insults or shout. I can excuse human error, but the receptionist's attitude is unacceptable.

In short, I received good service for 8 years, but I cannot recommend this place in the current state of affairs.
I've never seen such bad customer service. No follow-up, no service.

Hello, I ordered food for my dog, a bag of Royal Canin Multi-Function Renal Support Hydrolyzed Protein. I went to pick it up, and the receptionist made the same mistake twice: she ordered cat food (I don't even have a cat!), and she removed the cat's name from my file. The technician told me that this food was no longer available.

Veterinary emergency refused – loyal patient of 2 years

My dog, who had been a patient at this clinic for two years, could no longer open her eyes. We arrived in an emergency, without an appointment, but the receptionist refused to help us and even refused to see the veterinarian.

There was no support, no referral to another clinic, no compassion or professionalism, and above all, unacceptable management due to a complete lack of empathy and humanity.

After years of trust, this experience has deeply disappointed me. I strongly advise against this clinic.

I called on Monday to get a tranquilizer for my injured, aggressive cat. After two calls, I was told that since my cat hadn't seen a vet since 2021, technically, we were no longer clients. I asked for the vet to call me back, and I was told it would be done by the end of the day. I called again the next day, only to be told that as soon as the vet finished her appointment, she would call me back. Completely fed up, I ended up going to my old clinic, an hour's drive away. They saw me right away. The receptionist at 4 Pattes finally called me back early Thursday afternoon to tell me the tranquilizer was ready: "Ma'am, I've been waiting for you for four days, I went somewhere else." And the receptionist replied in the most disrespectful and condescending tone I've ever heard: "Ma'am, you call us and think we're going to call you back the same day?" "When I told her to change her tone, she hung up on me!!! Even my 12-year-old daughter couldn't believe it! I have three cats, all neutered and cared for there for almost ten years... I expected a minimum of empathy for my suffering cat and respect for me."

Loyal customer for the specialty food. The staff is always pleasant, but honestly, being turned away at 3 PM on a Wednesday because they're closing, on top of being closed Saturdays and Sundays, is very unreasonable.

Response: Your response is contradictory: you claim to want to improve your service, yet you're now closed Wednesdays, Saturdays, and Sundays 🤷🏼‍♀️
You have to be open to provide basic service.

Don't waste your time with this veterinary clinic. They'll tell you your medication is ready when it isn't, leaving you to fend for yourself. They'll charge exorbitant prices for their services and products. They even have trouble answering the phone. I don't know if they're disorganized or if they simply don't care. If you care about your pet, find a vet who does too.

Far too expensive, and some of the staff have a really bad approach to customers. They make mistakes and get angry with the customer. The bill was wrong, they snorted, made me feel uncomfortable, I really hated the experience, and I'd rather choose another vet with good customer service. I'm giving it a 2 because they treated my pet well. I understand they love animals, but I'm the customer who pays the bill. I wish I didn't have to feel uncomfortable asking questions and that the staff were well-informed about procedures. I had to travel to the clinic to take my pet in, even though I had clearly stated on the phone how long I'd had the animal. I expressed my dissatisfaction because I took time off work to bring him in, and they rudely told me to just come back another evening without apologizing for making a mistake. Of course, there were no more appointments available that evening when I returned to reception. Not to mention that my second appointment was canceled that same day without explanation, and I had to reschedule it. In winter, it's very slippery in front of the door, and they have no solution; they just said they tried and it's still slippery, so that's that. I think it's unacceptable. People come in with their pets in their arms or have accessibility issues, and they have to pray they don't slip. For an appointment, the estimate isn't shared with the client until the day of the surgery. I think it would be good to share it with the client beforehand; it's just a suggestion. I'm told I don't have to worry about the surgery; they'll call me beforehand to give me the information. The day before my appointment arrived, and I hadn't received a call. I had to look it up on Google to see how long before the surgery my pet needed to fast. I work in customer service, so I've tried to be understanding, but this has been too many unpleasant incidents. I'm going back to my old vet. He's in Laval, far from my home, but they treated my pet well and treated me with respect.

This clinic is clearly understaffed. Everyone is overwhelmed! Seeing how management treats its employees and puts them under unnecessary stress makes me not want to return or recommend your clinic. My two-star rating has absolutely nothing to do with the quality of service. The staff is very attentive and kind. Thank you so much to the team.

Vet's Logic

They require a $59 deposit to open a file. They might not have a vet available afterward, but I have to go make the deposit first! I told them, "If I show up with my cat instead of paying $50, you'll know I'm there for the appointment!" "Oh yeah, well, no, we can't... you don't have a file yet, so you have to pay $50."

So, according to them, it makes sense to come and make a $50 deposit when I'm far away, then come back to pick up my cat because the file is created, and then show up for the appointment with my cat afterward!

I'm waiting for the supervisor, who took four hours to call me back. Oops, no more appointments available for a week. Strangely, she said, "You have time to come and drop off the deposit now."

This place wants your money more than I want your pet. I'm on sick leave. I told myself it was disastrous for me, two round trips. I chose this one because it's the only one I have references for, and being autistic, it was very difficult for me without any references.

In short, avoid this place.

Not a good reception service. It doesn't make me want to come back.

Reply to the owner: My last visit was on the same day as my review. Given the poor service, I preferred to look elsewhere. So, it's normal that you don't have it in your records.
My trusted clinic.
We are pleased to know that you are satisfied with our care. We are always there for you and your pet, whatever the need.
Thank you for your review. We do our best to provide the best care that each of our clients and their furry friends needs and deserves. We hope to see you again soon. ⭐️
Thank you for this wonderful review, Ms. G. Houle. We look forward to seeing you again!
Good veterinary clinic. We've been clients for over 10 years.
A warm and welcoming team that cares about animal welfare!
Thank you, Ms. Fortin, for this perfect review! 🐾 We are very touched. Is there anything we could do to further improve your pets' experience on their next visit? …

One of the vets is really friendly, and the clinic is always spotless. I've been going there for three years now for vaccinations and annual checkups. Note: some services are overpriced compared to others, so be careful.

I consulted the vet about my 4-year-old cat who had yellow skin, significant weight loss, was no longer eating on his own, and had stopped exercising. Despite the limited tests my budget allowed, the vet quickly diagnosed him with hepatic lipidosis. Since I couldn't afford further testing, the team was able to guide and support me throughout the entire treatment. As a result, after less than two weeks of treatment, my cat was much better. He's been back to normal ever since. Thank you so much! :)

This is all new to me, these visits to the vet, but I really appreciate my visits to your clinic.

I find the staff to be very friendly, attentive, and patient, from the receptionists to the technicians and the vets.

I'm naturally anxious, and a year ago, I lost my beautiful Leo very suddenly after 15 years of love.
Now, I panic about everything and nothing concerning my cats' health, and the staff are always available to answer my questions, advise me, and reassure me.

Despite a comment below mentioning a push to sell products and services, I've had the opposite experience! At each visit/call, they advise me to try different things before resorting to a particular product or treatment, etc. I also really appreciated Dr. [Name omitted]. Dr. Hurtubise suggested I proceed step by step, eliminating options to avoid exorbitant costs. She also made sure that the financing was "suitable" for me.

Also, Dr. Hurtubise and Dr. Koprowska spent a great deal of time with me explaining everything, reassuring me, suggesting less expensive alternatives, and so on.

Thank you to the entire team for everything you do for our furry babies!
Thank you for this wonderful review! We are deeply touched by your trust and will continue to strive to provide you with exceptional service. Please give your pet a pat from us!

I went there with my puppy, and it was essentially a high-pressure sales pitch for vaccines, insurance, and food, with a very brief evaluation of the animal.

Furthermore, I was charged for a prescription because they didn't have a pill in stock (so I had to pay for the medication twice, in addition to the consultation and lab work).

On a positive note, the rest of the team was very kind and professional.
It's a pleasure to read your comment! We strive to provide you with 5-star service. 🙏 …

For over 15 years, the entire team has supported us with consistently excellent care and advice. We entrusted our beloved cat, nearing the end of her life, to them for her final journey, allowing her to pass away peacefully. Everything was handled with the utmost respect and professionalism. Thank you, Vét 4 Pattes!
A good local vet, the service is courteous and pleasant and the animals are well treated!
Thank you for this review, Ms. Brien! Our mission is to ensure that our clients, owners, and pets receive 5-star service! ⭐️
Wow, a very good place to go, excellent service and skills, thank you so much!

Thank you so much for this perfect review! 🌿 Your positive feedback means a lot to us, and we're delighted to be able to offer your pets the best possible care. See you soon for more attentive care! 🐕❤️ …

Excellent service, highly recommended 💯. They treat your pet well and make them feel like family. They call us when it's my cat's birthday, and when we go, they give her a little something. Excellent! …

Thank you for rating your experience at the clinic. Our priority is to provide exceptional service. If you feel the service you received could be improved, we sincerely apologize and hope you will give us a second chance to prove we can exceed your expectations.
A rushed diagnosis, hardly any questions asked. My dog ​​was dying and was diagnosed with gastroenteritis. $300 down the drain, and two days later my dog ​​died. Very disappointing.

Rude staff over the years with the exception of one lady. I kept getting emails after my pets died. When I called to make sure to remove me from all their lists I was met with another rude response instead of an apology.
